summary.en: Rumi Wakasa's neighbour is a pro-golfer named Teigo Banno. He has just won his first tournament in Japan and is about to move to the US to win even bigger titles. He talks to his girlfriend about his plans and asks her to return the spare key to his apartment. The conversation becomes an argument when he informs her he is going to the US alone. He wants to start his new life with a 'clean slate' and tells her they're breaking up. His girlfriend is a model, Kurumi Iiyama, who threatens him with a lawsuit of 100 Million Yen, relying on the power of her father, who is a lawyer. He calms her down and invites her to dinner to resolve the feud. While she is leaving, he murmurs, "This will be our last supper together." Wakasa overhears their conversation. The next day, we see Conan rehearsing his lines as 'Ikkyu' for the school play. Kobayashi-sensei, Rumi-sensei, and Conan's classmates are astonished by his incredible acting and the delivery of his lines. Conan had played 'Ikkyu-san' like Shinichi before, and his parents had trained him well. This is why, despite missing several rehearsals as Conan, he remembered most of his lines.
